valuationInputs.name: Beta
valuationInputs.reason: 8 steps, 19 Nov 2026. (1) Business: one business, renewable power (solar at Hambantota and Embilipitiya, mini hydro) sold to the CEB under fixed-tariff power purchase agreements. One sector beta. (2) Damodaran's emerging-markets dataset (betaEmerg) not opened from this run; the stand-in used for Vidullanka and WindForce: his global Green & Renewable Energy unlevered, cash-corrected beta 0.57 (January 2026). (3) Relevered with net debt Rs 1.55bn (30 Sep 2026) / market value Rs 3.85bn (335.0mn voting at Rs 10.20 + 52.0mn non-voting at Rs 8.30, CSE close 19 Nov 2026) = 0.40 and 30% tax (the solar tax holiday ended with 2025/26): 0.57 x (1 + 0.7 x 0.40) = 0.73. (4) Local 5-year betas: none found by web search (Simply Wall St shows 0.15 for the non-voting share, period not shown; the shares trade thinly), so step 4 can't be completed. (5) Higher of steps 3 and 4: 0.73. (6) Within 0.3-2. (7) Into the formula by scripts/reinvestment.py. Provisional: refresh in January 2027.

valuationInputs.name: Cost of equity
valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py (19 Nov 2026): 8.24% + 0.73 × (4.2% + 6.08%) = 15.7%, ±1.5 points. Replaces the hand-picked 17% / 15% / 13.5% discount rate.

valuationInputs.name: WACC
valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py (19 Nov 2026): cost of debt 8.31% (interest paid 0.147 ÷ average borrowings and leases 1.77, FY2026), tax 3.3% (FY2026 effective, inside the tax holiday), debt weight 28.2% (net debt Rs 1.55bn at Sep 2026, equity Rs 3.95bn at Rs 10.20).

valuationInputs.name: Growth check
valuationInputs.value: Assumed −1% / 0% / 1% (contract years); supported −5.2% (reinvestment rate −757% × return on capital 0.7%, FY2026). All more than 2 pts above: FY2026 had only Rs 0.031bn underlying operating profit and a Rs 0.187bn working-capital release, so the supported figure isn't representative; tariffs are fixed under the PPAs, the new Pams hydro plant adds a full year, and the bull's 1% needs Hambantota Phase 2.
valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py on the FY2026 figures, 19 Nov 2026.

valuationInputs.name: Methods used
valuationInputs.value: Whole-company DCF over 10 contract years + parent receivable (sotp), P/E, justified P/B (scripts/valuation.py); NAV multiple by hand; no dividend model (no dividend)
valuationInputs.reason: Brief applied in full on /redo full; replaces 'Cash-flow DCF over contract life; NAV multiple'.

valuationInputs.name: EBITDA a year
valuationInputs.reason: Last 12 months underlying EBITDA Rs 0.39bn (FY2026 0.29 less H1 FY2026 0.23 plus H1 FY2027 0.33); H1 FY2027 alone Rs 0.33bn with the new hydro plant, H2 seasonally weaker. FY2024–25 underlying about Rs 0.54–0.73bn.

valuationInputs.name: Maintenance capex basis
valuationInputs.reason: No company split. Calculator range 0.261 / 0.204 / 0.0; FY2026 capex was all named growth (Pams hydro, Hambantota Phase 1); FY2025 capex 0.071. Solar modules aren't replaced during the contracts and plant repairs (Rs 62mn) are expensed, so maintenance is 0.3–0.8x depreciation, below the usual range.

valuationInputs.name: Cash after maintenance capex (start)
valuationInputs.value: Bear Rs 0.20bn / Base Rs 0.33bn / Bull Rs 0.43bn
valuationInputs.reason: EBITDA less 30% tax on operating profit (EBITDA less about Rs 0.29bn depreciation) less maintenance. The calculator's start from FY2026 operating cash (0.18 / 0.24 / 0.44) is close.

valuationInputs.name: After-tax operating profit (start)
valuationInputs.reason: (EBITDA − Rs 0.29bn depreciation) × 70%; the solar tax holiday ended with 2025/26.

valuationInputs.name: Growth and contract life
valuationInputs.value: Ten years at −1% / 0% / 1%, then −5% / −3% / +1%; return on new capital 12%
valuationInputs.reason: Solar PPAs about 10 years left (Annual Report 2025/26, note 7.1.6); Pams hydro 20 years. Long run below WACC and the 12.24% bond yield; negative in bear/base for lower tariffs after the contracts.

valuationInputs.name: Parent receivable
valuationInputs.reason: Owed by LAUGFS Holdings at 31 March 2026 (note 12.2), on demand; the September figure isn't disclosed. Not in net debt, so added to the DCF.

valuationInputs.name: EPS to March 2027 × P/E
valuationInputs.reason: H1 EPS Rs 0.23; H2 is the weak season and now taxed at 30%. Justified forward P/E at the cost of equity from scripts/valuation.py. Run-rate check: base 76% below Rs 1.19 (FY2026, the reversal year); Q2 × 4 (Rs 0.68) is the monsoon peak.

valuationInputs.name: Long-run ROE
valuationInputs.reason: Underlying ROE about −3% in FY2026, about 6% annualised in H1 FY2027 (seasonal peak); used in P/E and justified P/B.

valuationInputs.name: NAV multiple
valuationInputs.reason: Book close to the company's own DCF of the plants, but returns about 4% on equity.

changeLog.summary: Requested from Telegram (/redo LPL.N0000 full). Research record rebuilt from the CSE copies of the 2025/26 annual report (read in full) and the September 2026 interim (scanned, read from page images). Corrections: most receivables are not the CEB's: Rs 521mn was owed by the parent, LAUGFS Holdings, and only Rs 204mn by the CEB (note 12); the solar tax holiday ended with 2025/26. Applied the current brief: beta 0.73 (provisional), cost of equity 15.7%, WACC 13.5%, whole-company DCF over the ten contract years plus the parent receivable, P/E and justified P/B added, NAV kept, reinvestment figures recorded, management, shareholders and required-return sections added. Fair value Rs 5.00 → 2.83 (P/E and P/B on about 4% underlying ROE, 30% tax, lower maintenance-adjusted cash). Business tests 1 of 4, category 3 unchanged.
